Name: Maru Redone (v2)
Author: 123frog
Description:
This is the second version of this mod because I wasn't completely happy with how the last turned out. I essentially mashed[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6375] Maru's hair and face by Pinzol[/url] with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Maru's body by Poltergeister[/url], and made a few edits along the way. If you want a version of Maru with more vanilla colours check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6375]Pinzol's Maru[/url]. Their mod completely inspired this one and recently got a great update.

To install simply drop "[CP] Maru V2" into your mods folder or use your mod manager of choice. Make sure you have [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] installed or this wont work.

This is compatible with version 1.6 and includes beach and winter outfits. Please let me know if you find any issues as I'm very new to modding.

[size=3][b]Credits[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/25655304]Pinzol[/url] is the original portrait and character sprite creator. Mine is mostly just a recolour of their hard work
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url] created the sprites for [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Characters-Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url], as well as the base I used for the scrubs
Though no assets were used, this was also heavily inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url]
